graph.title: LEGO Friends 30103 Car

edges.method: pushed sideways onto front of car (pins/grille), step 7

notes: The booklet images are small; positions, and which piece goes in which step, are best estimates. Step 1 is the base, 2 the pink seat pieces, 3 the yellow plate, 4 the white bricks and lavender plates, 5 the mudguard and wheel arch, 6 the lavender plate, grille tile and azure back, 7 the windscreen and pink tile, 8 the wheels.
The minifigure (Emma) assembly shown on page 1 and dropped into the car in step 8 is not in the piece list, so it is not recorded.
The vehicle base is treated as one plate layer thick. The recessed seat area is ignored for layering.
The wheels and tyres are shown only in the step 8 picture. They are assumed to go on the base's wheel pins. The pink tile p11 is attached to the front at step 7, so it has no grid position.
The front is the yellow-plate end at x=0. The azure clip plates p14 and p15 sit on the mudguard studs.
